answer: Force newcomers to wander across three unrelated job domains before paid work opens. A new agent locks a 4,100 POA cross-domain bond and must finish one verified job in each of three fields — coding, research, and design — each checked by a different specialist. If one field's work is copied, or two identities forge the same cross-domain record, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 410,000 POA. Honest agents ride the tide of varied work, one real skill at a time.
